learning_suggestions.Python: Complete an end-to-end data pipeline or scripting project using Python.
learning_suggestions.SQL: Practice complex joins, CTEs, and window functions on real datasets.
learning_suggestions.Machine Learning: Train, tune, and evaluate classification and regression models using scikit-learn.
learning_suggestions.Deep Learning: Build and train a neural network using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
learning_suggestions.Pandas: Work through data wrangling, cleaning, and group-by transformations on messy CSV data.
learning_suggestions.NumPy: Review vectorization, array manipulation, and linear algebra operations in NumPy.
learning_suggestions.Scikit-learn: Build reproducible ML pipelines using ColumnTransformer and cross-validation.
learning_suggestions.TensorFlow: Follow an official tutorial to build a CNN or sequential model with Keras/TensorFlow.
learning_suggestions.PyTorch: Implement custom PyTorch Datasets, Modules, and training loops.
learning_suggestions.FastAPI: Build and document high-performance REST APIs with Pydantic validation.
learning_suggestions.Flask: Create a lightweight web application or API service with Flask.
learning_suggestions.Django: Build a full-stack web application with Django models, ORM, and auth.
learning_suggestions.Docker: Containerize a Python application and manage environment dependencies with Docker.
learning_suggestions.Kubernetes: Learn basic cluster management, deployments, and service configs in Kubernetes.
learning_suggestions.Git: Practice branch management, merge conflict resolution, and pull requests on GitHub.
learning_suggestions.AWS: Deploy an application or serverless function on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda).
learning_suggestions.Azure: Familiarize yourself with Azure cloud storage, compute, and ML workspaces.
learning_suggestions.GCP: Explore Google Cloud Platform tools like BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Compute Engine.
learning_suggestions.Power BI: Build and publish interactive business intelligence dashboards and reports.
learning_suggestions.Tableau: Create and publish visual analytics stories and interactive dashboards in Tableau.
learning_suggestions.Excel: Master VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and advanced data analysis in Excel.
learning_suggestions.dbt: Learn data build tool (dbt) for SQL transformation and testing in data warehouses.
learning_suggestions.Hadoop: Study distributed storage and batch processing fundamentals in Apache Hadoop.
learning_suggestions.Spark: Write PySpark jobs for large-scale distributed data processing and analysis.
learning_suggestions.Airflow: Design directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to schedule and monitor data pipelines.
learning_suggestions.Computer Vision: Experiment with OpenCV for image processing and pre-trained vision models.
learning_suggestions.NLP: Process text data with tokenization, embeddings, and pre-trained language models.
learning_suggestions.Statistics: Review probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals.
learning_suggestions.JavaScript: Practice DOM manipulation, async/await, and ES6+ features in JavaScript.
learning_suggestions.React: Build component-based single-page applications with React hooks and state management.
learning_suggestions.Java: Review object-oriented programming, data structures, and Spring Boot basics in Java.
learning_suggestions.Linux: Familiarize yourself with bash scripting, file permissions, and process monitoring in Linux.
